title: product-description-requested
description: Published by backend (App\Services\Sqs\SqsPublisher, queue services.sqs.queues.product_description_requested) when an admin asks Filament to generate a product description. Consumed by the AI service (not yet built) to draft a description in the given locale. See docs/design.md. Lives under services/backend because that's the only side implemented so far; if the AI service ends up in a different language/repo layout, revisit whether this should move to a shared location instead of being duplicated.

locale.description: Target language for the generated description.

name.description: The product's existing translated name(s), keyed by locale, for context.

attributes.description: Freeform product attributes (weight, dimensions, ...), or null.
